work_history.title: Video Editor & Animator
work_history.description:
• Produce animated videos by integrating graphics, text and multimedia elements
• Designed and animated Google banners that aligned with campaign objectives
• Collaborated closely with cross-border teams in the US and UK team to conceptualise, design and produce video advertisements for international marketing campaigns.

work_history.title: VIDEO EDITOR/ ASSISTANT DIRECTOR
work_history.description:
• Edited commercial and social media videos, and applied post-production techniques to enhance the visual quality of the videos
• Collaborated with the social media team and creative teams to develop social media campaign ideas
• Worked closely with the director to brainstorm the idea and create storyboards
• Assist the director in organizing and coordinating all aspects of the production, from pre-production to post-production.

work_history.title: Production Assistant
work_history.description:
• Collaborated closely with the production team to set up various elements of the production, including sets, props, costumes, and equipment
• Provided the shot log report to the editing team to assist in the assembly and organization of footage during the editing process
• Coordinated with the assistant director to ensure that scenes were shot in the proper sequence to maintain continuity
